newsitem.title: USA: TCI launches buyback of Liberty Media shrs.
newsitem.headline: TCI launches buyback of Liberty Media shrs.

text.p: Tele-Communications said it launched a tender offer to buy back up to 10 million shares of its Liberty Media Group Series A and Series B Common Stock at a price of $27 per share.
The offer will remain open until 5 p.m. in New York City on September 17, TCI said.
The offer is part of a previously announced plan to buy back up to 55.5 million Liberty Media Group shares announced on August 15, 1996, TCI also said.
In 1997, TCI said it bought back 7.47 million shares at an average purchase price per share of $24.90.
The 10.0 million shares sought to be repurchased in the offer represent about 4.1 percent of Liberty Media's shares outstanding as of July 31, TCI said.
